consequence.statement: ClusterExternalSecret v1beta1 resources with spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion set to "v1" are rejected by the API server.
consequence.remediation: Change engineVersion to a value still allowed by the schema before upgrading.

original.statement: The v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema no longer allows "v1" for spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion, so resources setting it are rejected.

decision.reason: The validator checking the v0.15.0 and v0.16.0 CRD bundles [ev-9889c9b8706d, ev-e08924afdc47] confirmed that the v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret enum for spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion lost "v1", with nothing added. The computed diff states that a removed enum value is rejected by the API server, so v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecrets that set engineVersion to "v1" fail validation. That makes resource-rejected (mandatory work) the right kind. The evidence doesn't settle high versus medium severity, so I left "high" as proposed.
